#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `meter` | `string` | **yes** | The meter's id: the slug you chose. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `meter_credit_cost`. One of `meter_credit_cost`. |
| `meter` | `string` | The meter credit cost's meter. |
| `unit` | `string` | The meter credit cost's unit. |
| `credits_per_unit` | `string` | The meter credit cost's credits per unit. |
| `overrides` | `array of object` | The meter credit cost's overrides. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The credit cost. |
| `404` | No such meter, or the meter has no credit cost. |
| `409` | A price on a subscription bills the meter. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/meters/Meter/credit_cost" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
